hints.title: Parity Value Mapping
hints.text: Map even numbers to +1 and odd numbers to -1.

hints.title: Zero Sum Subarray Reduction
hints.text: An equal count of even and odd values corresponds to a contiguous subarray with sum equal to zero.

hints.title: Earliest Prefix Lookup
hints.text: Track the earliest index where each running prefix sum occurred using a hash map.

hints.title: Reference Implementation

complexity.notes: Single pass prefix sum with earliest seen index tracking.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Evaluating all subarrays naively takes O(N^2) time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: O(N) space for prefix sum dictionary.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Reduce parity balance to zero-sum prefix difference problem.
